34// Attach a data item to an object and delete it when the object gets
35// garbage-collected.
36// TODO: Replace this code with `napi_add_finalizer()` whenever it becomes
37// available on all supported versions of Node.js.
38template <typename FreeType>
39inline napi_status AttachData(napi_env env,
40 napi_value obj,
41 FreeType* data,
42 napi_finalize finalizer = nullptr,
43 void* hint = nullptr) {
44 napi_status status;
45 if (finalizer == nullptr) {
46 finalizer = [](napi_env /*env*/, void* data, void* /*hint*/) {
47 delete static_cast<FreeType*>(data);
48 };
49 }
50#if (NAPI_VERSION < 5)
51 napi_value symbol, external;
52 status = napi_create_symbol(env, nullptr, &symbol);
53 if (status == napi_ok) {
54 status = napi_create_external(env, data, finalizer, hint, &external);
55 if (status == napi_ok) {
56 napi_property_descriptor desc = {nullptr,
57 symbol,
58 nullptr,
59 nullptr,
60 nullptr,
61 external,
62 napi_default,
63 nullptr};
64 status = napi_define_properties(env, obj, 1, &desc);
65 }
66 }
67#else // NAPI_VERSION >= 5
68 status = napi_add_finalizer(env, obj, data, finalizer, hint, nullptr);
69#endif
70 return status;
71}

73// For use in JS to C++ callback wrappers to catch any Napi::Error exceptions
74// and rethrow them as JavaScript exceptions before returning from the callback.
75template <typename Callable>
76inline napi_value WrapCallback(Callable callback) {
77#ifdef NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
78 try {
79 return callback();
80 } catch (const Error& e) {
81 e.ThrowAsJavaScriptException();
82 return nullptr;
83 }
84#else // NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
85 // When C++ exceptions are disabled, errors are immediately thrown as JS
86 // exceptions, so there is no need to catch and rethrow them here.
87 return callback();
88#endif // NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
89}
90
91// For use in JS to C++ void callback wrappers to catch any Napi::Error
92// exceptions and rethrow them as JavaScript exceptions before returning from
93// the callback.
94template <typename Callable>
95inline void WrapVoidCallback(Callable callback) {
96#ifdef NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
97 try {
98 callback();
99 } catch (const Error& e) {
100 e.ThrowAsJavaScriptException();
101 }
102#else // NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
103 // When C++ exceptions are disabled, errors are immediately thrown as JS
104 // exceptions, so there is no need to catch and rethrow them here.
105 callback();
106#endif // NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
107}

109template <typename Callable, typename Return>
110struct CallbackData {
111 static inline napi_value Wrapper(napi_env env, napi_callback_info info) {
112 return details::WrapCallback([&] {
113 CallbackInfo callbackInfo(env, info);
114 CallbackData* callbackData =
115 static_cast<CallbackData*>(callbackInfo.Data());
116 callbackInfo.SetData(callbackData->data);
117 return callbackData->callback(callbackInfo);
118 });
119 }
120
121 Callable callback;
122 void* data;
123};

126struct CallbackData<Callable, void> {

128 return details::WrapCallback([&] {
129 CallbackInfo callbackInfo(env, info);
130 CallbackData* callbackData =
131 static_cast<CallbackData*>(callbackInfo.Data());
132 callbackInfo.SetData(callbackData->data);
133 callbackData->callback(callbackInfo);
134 return nullptr;
135 });
136 }
137
138 Callable callback;

140};

142template <void (*Callback)(const CallbackInfo& info)>
143napi_value TemplatedVoidCallback(napi_env env,
144 napi_callback_info info) NAPI_NOEXCEPT {
145 return details::WrapCallback([&] {
146 CallbackInfo cbInfo(env, info);
147 Callback(cbInfo);
148 return nullptr;

152template <Napi::Value (*Callback)(const CallbackInfo& info)>
153napi_value TemplatedCallback(napi_env env,
154 napi_callback_info info) NAPI_NOEXCEPT {
155 return details::WrapCallback([&] {
156 CallbackInfo cbInfo(env, info);
157 return Callback(cbInfo);

161template <typename T,
162 Napi::Value (T::*UnwrapCallback)(const CallbackInfo& info)>
163napi_value TemplatedInstanceCallback(napi_env env,
164 napi_callback_info info) NAPI_NOEXCEPT {
165 return details::WrapCallback([&] {
166 CallbackInfo cbInfo(env, info);
167 T* instance = T::Unwrap(cbInfo.This().As<Object>());
168 return instance ? (instance->*UnwrapCallback)(cbInfo) : Napi::Value();
169 });
170}
171
172template <typename T, void (T::*UnwrapCallback)(const CallbackInfo& info)>
173napi_value TemplatedInstanceVoidCallback(napi_env env, napi_callback_info info)
174 NAPI_NOEXCEPT {
175 return details::WrapCallback([&] {
176 CallbackInfo cbInfo(env, info);
177 T* instance = T::Unwrap(cbInfo.This().As<Object>());
178 if (instance) (instance->*UnwrapCallback)(cbInfo);
179 return nullptr;
180 });
181}

183template <typename T, typename Finalizer, typename Hint = void>
184struct FinalizeData {
185 static inline void Wrapper(napi_env env,
186 void* data,
187 void* finalizeHint) NAPI_NOEXCEPT {
188 WrapVoidCallback([&] {
189 FinalizeData* finalizeData = static_cast<FinalizeData*>(finalizeHint);
190 finalizeData->callback(Env(env), static_cast<T*>(data));
191 delete finalizeData;
192 });
193 }
194
195 static inline void WrapperWithHint(napi_env env,
196 void* data,
197 void* finalizeHint) NAPI_NOEXCEPT {
198 WrapVoidCallback([&] {
199 FinalizeData* finalizeData = static_cast<FinalizeData*>(finalizeHint);
200 finalizeData->callback(
201 Env(env), static_cast<T*>(data), finalizeData->hint);
202 delete finalizeData;
203 });
204 }
205
206 Finalizer callback;
207 Hint* hint;
208};

238 void* rawFinalizeData,

242 ThreadSafeFinalize* finalizeData =
243 static_cast<ThreadSafeFinalize*>(rawFinalizeData);

248 static inline void FinalizeFinalizeWrapperWithDataAndContext(

252 ThreadSafeFinalize* finalizeData =

254 finalizeData->callback(

257 }

264inline typename std::enable_if<call != static_cast<CallJs>(nullptr)>::type
265CallJsWrapper(napi_env env, napi_value jsCallback, void* context, void* data) {
266 call(env,
267 Function(env, jsCallback),
268 static_cast<ContextType*>(context),
269 static_cast<DataType*>(data));

273inline typename std::enable_if<call == static_cast<CallJs>(nullptr)>::type
274CallJsWrapper(napi_env env,
275 napi_value jsCallback,
276 void* /*context*/,
277 void* /*data*/) {
278 if (jsCallback != nullptr) {
279 Function(env, jsCallback).Call(0, nullptr);

306template <typename Getter, typename Setter>
307struct AccessorCallbackData {

309 napi_callback_info info) {
310 return details::WrapCallback([&] {

319 static inline napi_value SetterWrapper(napi_env env,
320 napi_callback_info info) {
321 return details::WrapCallback([&] {
322 CallbackInfo callbackInfo(env, info);
323 AccessorCallbackData* callbackData =
324 static_cast<AccessorCallbackData*>(callbackInfo.Data());
325 callbackInfo.SetData(callbackData->data);
326 callbackData->setterCallback(callbackInfo);
327 return nullptr;
328 });
329 }
330
331 Getter getterCallback;
332 Setter setterCallback;
333 void* data;
334};

343// Module registration
345
346// Register an add-on based on an initializer function.
347#define NODE_API_MODULE(modname, regfunc) \
348 static napi_value __napi_##regfunc(napi_env env, napi_value exports) { \
349 return Napi::RegisterModule(env, exports, regfunc); \
350 } \
351 NAPI_MODULE(modname, __napi_##regfunc)
352
353// Register an add-on based on a subclass of `Addon<T>` with a custom Node.js
354// module name.
355#define NODE_API_NAMED_ADDON(modname, classname) \
356 static napi_value __napi_##classname(napi_env env, napi_value exports) { \
357 return Napi::RegisterModule(env, exports, &classname::Init); \
358 } \
359 NAPI_MODULE(modname, __napi_##classname)
360
361// Register an add-on based on a subclass of `Addon<T>` with the Node.js module
362// name given by node-gyp from the `target_name` in binding.gyp.
363#define NODE_API_ADDON(classname) \
364 NODE_API_NAMED_ADDON(NODE_GYP_MODULE_NAME, classname)
365
366// Adapt the NAPI_MODULE registration function:
367// - Wrap the arguments in NAPI wrappers.
368// - Catch any NAPI errors and rethrow as JS exceptions.
369inline napi_value RegisterModule(napi_env env,
370 napi_value exports,
371 ModuleRegisterCallback registerCallback) {
372 return details::WrapCallback([&] {
373 return napi_value(
374 registerCallback(Napi::Env(env), Napi::Object(env, exports)));
375 });
376}

382template <class T>
383bool Maybe<T>::IsNothing() const {
384 return !_has_value;
385}

387template <class T>
388bool Maybe<T>::IsJust() const {
389 return _has_value;
390}

392template <class T>
393void Maybe<T>::Check() const {

397template <class T>
398T Maybe<T>::Unwrap() const {
399 NAPI_CHECK(IsJust(), "Napi::Maybe::Unwrap", "Maybe value is Nothing.");
400 return _value;
401}
402
403template <class T>
404T Maybe<T>::UnwrapOr(const T& default_value) const {
405 return _has_value ? _value : default_value;
406}
407
408template <class T>
409bool Maybe<T>::UnwrapTo(T* out) const {
410 if (IsJust()) {
411 *out = _value;
412 return true;
413 };
414 return false;
415}
416
417template <class T>
418bool Maybe<T>::operator==(const Maybe& other) const {
419 return (IsJust() == other.IsJust()) &&
420 (!IsJust() || Unwrap() == other.Unwrap());
421}

423template <class T>
424bool Maybe<T>::operator!=(const Maybe& other) const {
425 return !operator==(other);
426}

432Maybe<T>::Maybe(const T& t) : _has_value(true), _value(t) {}

435inline Maybe<T> Nothing() {

475inline bool Env::IsExceptionPending() const {
476 bool result;
477 napi_status status = napi_is_exception_pending(_env, &result);
478 if (status != napi_ok)
479 result = false; // Checking for a pending exception shouldn't throw.
480 return result;
481}

483inline Error Env::GetAndClearPendingException() const {
484 napi_value value;
485 napi_status status = napi_get_and_clear_last_exception(_env, &value);
486 if (status != napi_ok) {
487 // Don't throw another exception when failing to get the exception!
488 return Error();
489 }
490 return Error(_env, value);
491}

1121
1122 std::u16string value;
1123 value.reserve(length + 1);
1124 value.resize(length);
1125 status = napi_get_value_string_utf16(
1126 _env, _value, &value[0], value.capacity(), nullptr);

1159inline MaybeOrValue<Symbol> Symbol::WellKnown(napi_env env,
1160 const std::string& name) {
1161#if defined(NODE_ADDON_API_ENABLE_MAYBE)
1162 Value symbol_obj;
1163 Value symbol_value;
1164 if (Napi::Env(env).Global().Get("Symbol").UnwrapTo(&symbol_obj) &&
1165 symbol_obj.As<Object>().Get(name).UnwrapTo(&symbol_value)) {
1166 return Just<Symbol>(symbol_value.As<Symbol>());
1167 }
1168 return Nothing<Symbol>();
1169#else
1170 return Napi::Env(env)
1171 .Global()
1172 .Get("Symbol")
1173 .As<Object>()
1174 .Get(name)
1175 .As<Symbol>();
1176#endif
1177}

1194inline MaybeOrValue<Symbol> Symbol::For(napi_env env, napi_value description) {
1195#if defined(NODE_ADDON_API_ENABLE_MAYBE)
1196 Value symbol_obj;
1197 Value symbol_for_value;
1198 Value symbol_value;
1199 if (Napi::Env(env).Global().Get("Symbol").UnwrapTo(&symbol_obj) &&
1200 symbol_obj.As<Object>().Get("for").UnwrapTo(&symbol_for_value) &&
1201 symbol_for_value.As<Function>()
1202 .Call(symbol_obj, {description})
1203 .UnwrapTo(&symbol_value)) {
1204 return Just<Symbol>(symbol_value.As<Symbol>());
1205 }
1206 return Nothing<Symbol>();
1207#else
1208 Object symbol_obj = Napi::Env(env).Global().Get("Symbol").As<Object>();
1209 return symbol_obj.Get("for")
1210 .As<Function>()
1211 .Call(symbol_obj, {description})
1212 .As<Symbol>();
1213#endif
1214}

1231// Automagic value creation
1233
1234namespace details {
1235template <typename T>
1236struct vf_number {
1237 static Number From(napi_env env, T value) {
1238 return Number::New(env, static_cast<double>(value));
1239 }
1240};
1241
1242template <>
1243struct vf_number<bool> {
1244 static Boolean From(napi_env env, bool value) {
1245 return Boolean::New(env, value);
1246 }
1247};
1248
1249struct vf_utf8_charp {
1250 static String From(napi_env env, const char* value) {
1251 return String::New(env, value);
1252 }
1253};
1254
1255struct vf_utf16_charp {
1256 static String From(napi_env env, const char16_t* value) {
1257 return String::New(env, value);
1258 }
1259};
1260struct vf_utf8_string {
1261 static String From(napi_env env, const std::string& value) {
1262 return String::New(env, value);
1263 }
1264};
1265
1266struct vf_utf16_string {
1267 static String From(napi_env env, const std::u16string& value) {
1268 return String::New(env, value);
1269 }
1270};
1271
1272template <typename T>
1273struct vf_fallback {
1274 static Value From(napi_env env, const T& value) { return Value(env, value); }
1275};
1276
1277template <typename...>
1278struct disjunction : std::false_type {};
1279template <typename B>
1280struct disjunction<B> : B {};
1281template <typename B, typename... Bs>
1282struct disjunction<B, Bs...>
1283 : std::conditional<bool(B::value), B, disjunction<Bs...>>::type {};
1284
1285template <typename T>
1286struct can_make_string
1287 : disjunction<typename std::is_convertible<T, const char*>::type,
1288 typename std::is_convertible<T, const char16_t*>::type,
1289 typename std::is_convertible<T, std::string>::type,
1290 typename std::is_convertible<T, std::u16string>::type> {};
1291} // namespace details
1292
1293template <typename T>
1294Value Value::From(napi_env env, const T& value) {
1295 using Helper = typename std::conditional<
1296 std::is_integral<T>::value || std::is_floating_point<T>::value,
1297 details::vf_number<T>,
1298 typename std::conditional<details::can_make_string<T>::value,
1299 String,
1300 details::vf_fallback<T>>::type>::type;
1301 return Helper::From(env, value);
1302}
1303
1304template <typename T>
1305String String::From(napi_env env, const T& value) {
1306 struct Dummy {};
1307 using Helper = typename std::conditional<
1308 std::is_convertible<T, const char*>::value,
1309 details::vf_utf8_charp,
1310 typename std::conditional<
1311 std::is_convertible<T, const char16_t*>::value,
1312 details::vf_utf16_charp,
1313 typename std::conditional<
1314 std::is_convertible<T, std::string>::value,
1315 details::vf_utf8_string,
1316 typename std::conditional<
1317 std::is_convertible<T, std::u16string>::value,
1318 details::vf_utf16_string,
1319 Dummy>::type>::type>::type>::type;
1320 return Helper::From(env, value);
1321}

1621template <typename Finalizer, typename T>
1622inline void Object::AddFinalizer(Finalizer finalizeCallback, T* data) const {
1623 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer>* finalizeData =
1624 new details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer>(
1625 {std::move(finalizeCallback), nullptr});
1626 napi_status status =
1627 details::AttachData(_env,
1628 *this,
1629 data,
1630 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer>::Wrapper,
1631 finalizeData);
1632 if (status != napi_ok) {
1633 delete finalizeData;
1634 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED_VOID(_env, status);
1635 }
1636}
1637
1638template <typename Finalizer, typename T, typename Hint>
1639inline void Object::AddFinalizer(Finalizer finalizeCallback,
1640 T* data,
1641 Hint* finalizeHint) const {
1642 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer, Hint>* finalizeData =
1643 new details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer, Hint>(
1644 {std::move(finalizeCallback), finalizeHint});
1645 napi_status status = details::AttachData(
1646 _env,
1647 *this,
1648 data,
1649 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer, Hint>::WrapperWithHint,
1650 finalizeData);
1651 if (status != napi_ok) {
1652 delete finalizeData;
1653 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED_VOID(_env, status);
1654 }
1655}

1996inline DataView DataView::New(napi_env env,
1997 Napi::ArrayBuffer arrayBuffer,
1998 size_t byteOffset) {
1999 if (byteOffset > arrayBuffer.ByteLength()) {
2000 NAPI_THROW(RangeError::New(
2001 env, "Start offset is outside the bounds of the buffer"),
2002 DataView());
2003 }
2004 return New(
2005 env, arrayBuffer, byteOffset, arrayBuffer.ByteLength() - byteOffset);
2006}

2008inline DataView DataView::New(napi_env env,
2009 Napi::ArrayBuffer arrayBuffer,
2010 size_t byteOffset,
2011 size_t byteLength) {
2012 if (byteOffset + byteLength > arrayBuffer.ByteLength()) {
2013 NAPI_THROW(RangeError::New(env, "Invalid DataView length"), DataView());
2014 }
2015 napi_value value;
2016 napi_status status =
2017 napi_create_dataview(env, byteLength, arrayBuffer, byteOffset, &value);
2018 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, DataView());
2019 return DataView(env, value);
2020}

2140template <typename T>
2141inline T DataView::ReadData(size_t byteOffset) const {
2142 if (byteOffset + sizeof(T) > _length ||
2143 byteOffset + sizeof(T) < byteOffset) { // overflow
2144 NAPI_THROW(
2145 RangeError::New(_env, "Offset is outside the bounds of the DataView"),
2146 0);
2147 }
2148
2149 return *reinterpret_cast<T*>(static_cast<uint8_t*>(_data) + byteOffset);
2150}
2151
2152template <typename T>
2153inline void DataView::WriteData(size_t byteOffset, T value) const {
2154 if (byteOffset + sizeof(T) > _length ||
2155 byteOffset + sizeof(T) < byteOffset) { // overflow
2156 NAPI_THROW_VOID(
2157 RangeError::New(_env, "Offset is outside the bounds of the DataView"));
2158 }
2159
2160 *reinterpret_cast<T*>(static_cast<uint8_t*>(_data) + byteOffset) = value;
2161}

2259 TypedArray::CheckCast(env, value);
2260 napi_typedarray_type type;

2262 env, value, &type, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
2263 NAPI_CHECK(status == napi_ok,
2264 "TypedArrayOf::CheckCast",
2265 "napi_is_typedarray failed");
2266
2267 NAPI_CHECK(
2268 (type == TypedArrayTypeForPrimitiveType<T>() ||
2269 (type == napi_uint8_clamped_array && std::is_same<T, uint8_t>::value)),
2270 "TypedArrayOf::CheckCast",
2271 "Array type must match the template parameter. (Uint8 arrays may "

2419template <typename Callable>
2420inline Function Function::New(napi_env env,
2421 Callable cb,
2422 const char* utf8name,
2423 void* data) {
2424 using ReturnType = decltype(cb(CallbackInfo(nullptr, nullptr)));

2498inline MaybeOrValue<Value> Function::Call(
2499 napi_value recv, const std::vector<Value>& args) const {
2500 const size_t argc = args.size();
2501 const size_t stackArgsCount = 6;
2502 napi_value stackArgs[stackArgsCount];
2503 std::vector<napi_value> heapArgs;
2504 napi_value* argv;
2505 if (argc <= stackArgsCount) {
2506 argv = stackArgs;
2507 } else {
2508 heapArgs.resize(argc);
2509 argv = heapArgs.data();
2510 }
2511
2512 for (size_t index = 0; index < argc; index++) {
2513 argv[index] = static_cast<napi_value>(args[index]);
2514 }
2515
2516 return Call(recv, argc, argv);
2517}

2520 size_t argc,
2521 const napi_value* args) const {
2522 napi_value result;
2523 napi_status status =
2524 napi_call_function(_env, recv, _value, argc, args, &result);
2525 NAPI_RETURN_OR_THROW_IF_FAILED(
2526 _env, status, Napi::Value(_env, result), Napi::Value);
2527}

2619template <typename T>
2620inline Buffer<T> Buffer<T>::New(napi_env env, size_t length) {
2621 napi_value value;
2622 void* data;
2623 napi_status status =
2624 napi_create_buffer(env, length * sizeof(T), &data, &value);
2625 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, Buffer<T>());
2626 return Buffer(env, value, length, static_cast<T*>(data));
2627}
2628
2629#ifndef NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED
2630template <typename T>
2631inline Buffer<T> Buffer<T>::New(napi_env env, T* data, size_t length) {
2632 napi_value value;
2633 napi_status status = napi_create_external_buffer(
2634 env, length * sizeof(T), data, nullptr, nullptr, &value);
2635 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, Buffer<T>());
2636 return Buffer(env, value, length, data);
2637}
2638
2639template <typename T>
2640template <typename Finalizer>
2641inline Buffer<T> Buffer<T>::New(napi_env env,
2642 T* data,
2643 size_t length,
2644 Finalizer finalizeCallback) {
2645 napi_value value;
2646 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer>* finalizeData =
2647 new details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer>(
2648 {std::move(finalizeCallback), nullptr});
2649 napi_status status =
2650 napi_create_external_buffer(env,
2651 length * sizeof(T),
2652 data,
2653 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer>::Wrapper,
2654 finalizeData,
2655 &value);
2656 if (status != napi_ok) {
2657 delete finalizeData;
2658 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, Buffer());
2659 }
2660 return Buffer(env, value, length, data);
2661}
2662
2663template <typename T>
2664template <typename Finalizer, typename Hint>
2665inline Buffer<T> Buffer<T>::New(napi_env env,
2666 T* data,
2667 size_t length,
2668 Finalizer finalizeCallback,
2669 Hint* finalizeHint) {
2670 napi_value value;
2671 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer, Hint>* finalizeData =
2672 new details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer, Hint>(
2673 {std::move(finalizeCallback), finalizeHint});
2674 napi_status status = napi_create_external_buffer(
2675 env,
2676 length * sizeof(T),
2677 data,
2678 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer, Hint>::WrapperWithHint,
2679 finalizeData,
2680 &value);
2681 if (status != napi_ok) {
2682 delete finalizeData;
2683 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, Buffer());
2684 }
2685 return Buffer(env, value, length, data);
2686}
2687#endif // NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED
2688
2689template <typename T>
2690inline Buffer<T> Buffer<T>::NewOrCopy(napi_env env, T* data, size_t length) {
2691#ifndef NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED
2692 napi_value value;
2693 napi_status status = napi_create_external_buffer(
2694 env, length * sizeof(T), data, nullptr, nullptr, &value);
2695 if (status == details::napi_no_external_buffers_allowed) {
2696#endif // NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED
2697 // If we can't create an external buffer, we'll just copy the data.
2698 return Buffer<T>::Copy(env, data, length);
2699#ifndef NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED
2700 }
2701 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, Buffer<T>());
2702 return Buffer(env, value, length, data);
2703#endif // NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED
2704}
2705
2706template <typename T>
2707template <typename Finalizer>
2708inline Buffer<T> Buffer<T>::NewOrCopy(napi_env env,
2709 T* data,
2710 size_t length,
2711 Finalizer finalizeCallback) {
2712 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer>* finalizeData =
2713 new details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer>(
2714 {std::move(finalizeCallback), nullptr});
2715#ifndef NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED
2716 napi_value value;
2717 napi_status status =
2718 napi_create_external_buffer(env,
2719 length * sizeof(T),
2720 data,
2721 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer>::Wrapper,
2722 finalizeData,
2723 &value);
2724 if (status == details::napi_no_external_buffers_allowed) {
2725#endif // NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED
2726 // If we can't create an external buffer, we'll just copy the data.
2727 Buffer<T> ret = Buffer<T>::Copy(env, data, length);
2728 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer>::Wrapper(env, data, finalizeData);
2729 return ret;
2730#ifndef NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED
2731 }
2732 if (status != napi_ok) {
2733 delete finalizeData;
2734 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, Buffer());
2735 }
2736 return Buffer(env, value, length, data);
2737#endif // NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED
2738}
2739
2740template <typename T>
2741template <typename Finalizer, typename Hint>
2742inline Buffer<T> Buffer<T>::NewOrCopy(napi_env env,
2743 T* data,
2744 size_t length,
2745 Finalizer finalizeCallback,
2746 Hint* finalizeHint) {
2747 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer, Hint>* finalizeData =
2748 new details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer, Hint>(
2749 {std::move(finalizeCallback), finalizeHint});
2750#ifndef NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED
2751 napi_value value;
2752 napi_status status = napi_create_external_buffer(
2753 env,
2754 length * sizeof(T),
2755 data,
2756 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer, Hint>::WrapperWithHint,
2757 finalizeData,
2758 &value);
2759 if (status == details::napi_no_external_buffers_allowed) {
2760#endif
2761 // If we can't create an external buffer, we'll just copy the data.
2762 Buffer<T> ret = Buffer<T>::Copy(env, data, length);
2763 details::FinalizeData<T, Finalizer, Hint>::WrapperWithHint(
2764 env, data, finalizeData);
2765 return ret;
2766#ifndef NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED
2767 }
2768 if (status != napi_ok) {
2769 delete finalizeData;
2770 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, Buffer());
2771 }
2772 return Buffer(env, value, length, data);
2773#endif
2774}

2818template <typename T>
2819inline void Buffer<T>::EnsureInfo() const {
2820 // The Buffer instance may have been constructed from a napi_value whose
2821 // length/data are not yet known. Fetch and cache these values just once,
2822 // since they can never change during the lifetime of the Buffer.
2823 if (_data == nullptr) {
2824 size_t byteLength;
2825 void* voidData;
2826 napi_status status =
2827 napi_get_buffer_info(_env, _value, &voidData, &byteLength);
2828 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED_VOID(_env, status);
2829 _length = byteLength / sizeof(T);
2830 _data = static_cast<T*>(voidData);
2831 }
2832}

2835// Error class
2837
2838inline Error Error::New(napi_env env) {
2839 napi_status status;
2840 napi_value error = nullptr;
2841 bool is_exception_pending;
2842 napi_extended_error_info last_error_info_copy;
2843
2844 {
2845 // We must retrieve the last error info before doing anything else because
2846 // doing anything else will replace the last error info.
2847 const napi_extended_error_info* last_error_info;
2848 status = napi_get_last_error_info(env, &last_error_info);
2849 NAPI_FATAL_IF_FAILED(status, "Error::New", "napi_get_last_error_info");
2850
2851 // All fields of the `napi_extended_error_info` structure gets reset in
2852 // subsequent Node-API function calls on the same `env`. This includes a
2853 // call to `napi_is_exception_pending()`. So here it is necessary to make a
2854 // copy of the information as the `error_code` field is used later on.
2855 memcpy(&last_error_info_copy,
2856 last_error_info,
2857 sizeof(napi_extended_error_info));
2858 }
2859
2860 status = napi_is_exception_pending(env, &is_exception_pending);
2861 NAPI_FATAL_IF_FAILED(status, "Error::New", "napi_is_exception_pending");
2862
2863 // A pending exception takes precedence over any internal error status.
2864 if (is_exception_pending) {
2865 status = napi_get_and_clear_last_exception(env, &error);
2866 NAPI_FATAL_IF_FAILED(
2867 status, "Error::New", "napi_get_and_clear_last_exception");
2868 } else {
2869 const char* error_message = last_error_info_copy.error_message != nullptr
2870 ? last_error_info_copy.error_message
2871 : "Error in native callback";
2872
2873 napi_value message;
2874 status = napi_create_string_utf8(
2875 env, error_message, std::strlen(error_message), &message);
2876 NAPI_FATAL_IF_FAILED(status, "Error::New", "napi_create_string_utf8");
2877
2878 switch (last_error_info_copy.error_code) {
2879 case napi_object_expected:
2880 case napi_string_expected:
2881 case napi_boolean_expected:
2882 case napi_number_expected:
2883 status = napi_create_type_error(env, nullptr, message, &error);
2884 break;
2885 default:
2886 status = napi_create_error(env, nullptr, message, &error);
2887 break;
2888 }
2889 NAPI_FATAL_IF_FAILED(status, "Error::New", "napi_create_error");
2890 }
2891
2892 return Error(env, error);
2893}

2910inline Error::Error() : ObjectReference() {}
2911
2912inline Error::Error(napi_env env, napi_value value)
2913 : ObjectReference(env, nullptr) {
2914 if (value != nullptr) {
2915 // Attempting to create a reference on the error object.
2916 // If it's not a Object/Function/Symbol, this call will return an error
2917 // status.
2918 napi_status status = napi_create_reference(env, value, 1, &_ref);
2919
2920 if (status != napi_ok) {
2921 napi_value wrappedErrorObj;
2922
2923 // Create an error object
2924 status = napi_create_object(env, &wrappedErrorObj);
2925 NAPI_FATAL_IF_FAILED(status, "Error::Error", "napi_create_object");
2926
2927 // property flag that we attach to show the error object is wrapped
2928 napi_property_descriptor wrapObjFlag = {
2929 ERROR_WRAP_VALUE(), // Unique GUID identifier since Symbol isn't a
2930 // viable option
2931 nullptr,
2932 nullptr,
2933 nullptr,
2934 nullptr,
2935 Value::From(env, value),
2936 napi_enumerable,
2937 nullptr};
2938
2939 status = napi_define_properties(env, wrappedErrorObj, 1, &wrapObjFlag);
2940#ifdef NODE_API_SWALLOW_UNTHROWABLE_EXCEPTIONS
2941 if (status == napi_pending_exception) {
2942 // Test if the pending exception was reported because the environment is
2943 // shutting down. We assume that a status of napi_pending_exception
2944 // coupled with the absence of an actual pending exception means that
2945 // the environment is shutting down. If so, we replace the
2946 // napi_pending_exception status with napi_ok.
2947 bool is_exception_pending = false;
2948 status = napi_is_exception_pending(env, &is_exception_pending);
2949 if (status == napi_ok && !is_exception_pending) {
2950 status = napi_ok;
2951 } else {
2952 status = napi_pending_exception;
2953 }
2954 }
2955#endif // NODE_API_SWALLOW_UNTHROWABLE_EXCEPTIONS
2956 NAPI_FATAL_IF_FAILED(status, "Error::Error", "napi_define_properties");
2957
2958 // Create a reference on the newly wrapped object
2959 status = napi_create_reference(env, wrappedErrorObj, 1, &_ref);
2960 }
2961
2962 // Avoid infinite recursion in the failure case.
2963 NAPI_FATAL_IF_FAILED(status, "Error::Error", "napi_create_reference");
2964 }
2965}
2966
2967inline Object Error::Value() const {
2968 if (_ref == nullptr) {
2969 return Object(_env, nullptr);
2970 }
2971
2972 napi_value refValue;
2973 napi_status status = napi_get_reference_value(_env, _ref, &refValue);
2974 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(_env, status, Object());
2975
2976 napi_valuetype type;
2977 status = napi_typeof(_env, refValue, &type);
2978 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(_env, status, Object());
2979
2980 // If refValue isn't a symbol, then we proceed to whether the refValue has the
2981 // wrapped error flag
2982 if (type != napi_symbol) {
2983 // We are checking if the object is wrapped
2984 bool isWrappedObject = false;
2985
2986 status = napi_has_property(_env,
2987 refValue,
2988 String::From(_env, ERROR_WRAP_VALUE()),
2989 &isWrappedObject);
2990
2991 // Don't care about status
2992 if (isWrappedObject) {
2993 napi_value unwrappedValue;
2994 status = napi_get_property(_env,
2995 refValue,
2996 String::From(_env, ERROR_WRAP_VALUE()),
2997 &unwrappedValue);
2998 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(_env, status, Object());
2999
3000 return Object(_env, unwrappedValue);
3001 }
3002 }
3003
3004 return Object(_env, refValue);
3005}

3024 napi_status status = napi_create_reference(_env, value, 1, &_ref);
3025 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(_env, status, *this);
3026 }
3027
3028 return *this;

3031inline const std::string& Error::Message() const NAPI_NOEXCEPT {
3032 if (_message.size() == 0 && _env != nullptr) {
3033#ifdef NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
3034 try {
3035 _message = Get("message").As<String>();
3036 } catch (...) {
3037 // Catch all errors here, to include e.g. a std::bad_alloc from
3038 // the std::string::operator=, because this method may not throw.
3039 }
3040#else // NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
3041#if defined(NODE_ADDON_API_ENABLE_MAYBE)
3042 Napi::Value message_val;
3043 if (Get("message").UnwrapTo(&message_val)) {
3044 _message = message_val.As<String>();
3045 }
3046#else
3047 _message = Get("message").As<String>();
3048#endif
3049#endif // NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
3050 }
3051 return _message;
3052}

3054// we created an object on the &_ref
3055inline void Error::ThrowAsJavaScriptException() const {
3056 HandleScope scope(_env);
3057 if (!IsEmpty()) {
3058#ifdef NODE_API_SWALLOW_UNTHROWABLE_EXCEPTIONS
3059 bool pendingException = false;
3060
3061 // check if there is already a pending exception. If so don't try to throw a
3062 // new one as that is not allowed/possible
3063 napi_status status = napi_is_exception_pending(_env, &pendingException);
3064
3065 if ((status != napi_ok) ||
3066 ((status == napi_ok) && (pendingException == false))) {
3067 // We intentionally don't use `NAPI_THROW_*` macros here to ensure
3068 // that there is no possible recursion as `ThrowAsJavaScriptException`
3069 // is part of `NAPI_THROW_*` macro definition for noexcept.
3070
3071 status = napi_throw(_env, Value());
3072
3073 if (status == napi_pending_exception) {
3074 // The environment must be terminating as we checked earlier and there
3075 // was no pending exception. In this case continuing will result
3076 // in a fatal error and there is nothing the author has done incorrectly
3077 // in their code that is worth flagging through a fatal error
3078 return;
3079 }
3080 } else {
3081 status = napi_pending_exception;
3082 }
3083#else
3084 // We intentionally don't use `NAPI_THROW_*` macros here to ensure
3085 // that there is no possible recursion as `ThrowAsJavaScriptException`
3086 // is part of `NAPI_THROW_*` macro definition for noexcept.
3087
3088 napi_status status = napi_throw(_env, Value());
3089#endif
3090
3091#ifdef NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
3092 if (status != napi_ok) {
3093 throw Error::New(_env);
3094 }
3095#else // NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
3096 NAPI_FATAL_IF_FAILED(
3097 status, "Error::ThrowAsJavaScriptException", "napi_throw");
3098#endif // NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
3099 }
3100}

3742// CallbackInfo class
3744
3745inline CallbackInfo::CallbackInfo(napi_env env, napi_callback_info info)
3746 : _env(env),
3747 _info(info),
3748 _this(nullptr),
3749 _dynamicArgs(nullptr),
3750 _data(nullptr) {
3751 _argc = _staticArgCount;
3752 _argv = _staticArgs;
3753 napi_status status =
3754 napi_get_cb_info(env, info, &_argc, _argv, &_this, &_data);
3755 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED_VOID(_env, status);
3756
3757 if (_argc > _staticArgCount) {
3758 // Use either a fixed-size array (on the stack) or a dynamically-allocated
3759 // array (on the heap) depending on the number of args.
3760 _dynamicArgs = new napi_value[_argc];
3761 _argv = _dynamicArgs;
3762
3763 status = napi_get_cb_info(env, info, &_argc, _argv, nullptr, nullptr);
3764 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED_VOID(_env, status);
3765 }
3766}
3767
3768inline CallbackInfo::~CallbackInfo() {
3769 if (_dynamicArgs != nullptr) {
3770 delete[] _dynamicArgs;
3771 }
3772}
3773
3774inline CallbackInfo::operator napi_callback_info() const {
3775 return _info;
3776}
3777
3778inline Value CallbackInfo::NewTarget() const {
3779 napi_value newTarget;
3780 napi_status status = napi_get_new_target(_env, _info, &newTarget);
3781 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(_env, status, Value());
3782 return Value(_env, newTarget);
3783}
3784
3785inline bool CallbackInfo::IsConstructCall() const {
3786 return !NewTarget().IsEmpty();
3787}
3788
3789inline Napi::Env CallbackInfo::Env() const {
3790 return Napi::Env(_env);
3791}
3792
3793inline size_t CallbackInfo::Length() const {
3794 return _argc;
3795}
3796
3797inline const Value CallbackInfo::operator[](size_t index) const {
3798 return index < _argc ? Value(_env, _argv[index]) : Env().Undefined();
3799}
3800
3801inline Value CallbackInfo::This() const {
3802 if (_this == nullptr) {
3803 return Env().Undefined();
3804 }
3805 return Object(_env, _this);
3806}
3807
3808inline void* CallbackInfo::Data() const {
3809 return _data;
3810}

3813 _data = data;

3893template <typename Getter>
3894inline PropertyDescriptor PropertyDescriptor::Accessor(
3895 Napi::Env env,
3896 Napi::Object object,
3897 const char* utf8name,
3898 Getter getter,
3899 napi_property_attributes attributes,
3900 void* data) {
3901 using CbData = details::CallbackData<Getter, Napi::Value>;
3902 auto callbackData = new CbData({getter, data});
3903
3904 napi_status status = AttachData(env, object, callbackData);
3905 if (status != napi_ok) {
3906 delete callbackData;
3907 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, napi_property_descriptor());
3908 }
3909
3910 return PropertyDescriptor({utf8name,
3911 nullptr,
3912 nullptr,
3913 CbData::Wrapper,
3914 nullptr,
3915 nullptr,
3916 attributes,
3917 callbackData});
3918}

4120// InstanceWrap<T> class
4122
4123template <typename T>
4124inline void InstanceWrap<T>::AttachPropData(
4125 napi_env env, napi_value value, const napi_property_descriptor* prop) {
4126 napi_status status;
4127 if (!(prop->attributes & napi_static)) {
4128 if (prop->method == T::InstanceVoidMethodCallbackWrapper) {
4129 status = Napi::details::AttachData(
4130 env, value, static_cast<InstanceVoidMethodCallbackData*>(prop->data));
4131 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED_VOID(env, status);
4132 } else if (prop->method == T::InstanceMethodCallbackWrapper) {
4133 status = Napi::details::AttachData(
4134 env, value, static_cast<InstanceMethodCallbackData*>(prop->data));
4135 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED_VOID(env, status);
4136 } else if (prop->getter == T::InstanceGetterCallbackWrapper ||
4137 prop->setter == T::InstanceSetterCallbackWrapper) {
4138 status = Napi::details::AttachData(
4139 env, value, static_cast<InstanceAccessorCallbackData*>(prop->data));
4140 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED_VOID(env, status);
4141 }
4142 }
4143}

4145template <typename T>

4349template <typename T>
4350inline napi_value InstanceWrap<T>::InstanceVoidMethodCallbackWrapper(
4351 napi_env env, napi_callback_info info) {
4352 return details::WrapCallback([&] {
4353 CallbackInfo callbackInfo(env, info);
4354 InstanceVoidMethodCallbackData* callbackData =
4355 reinterpret_cast<InstanceVoidMethodCallbackData*>(callbackInfo.Data());
4356 callbackInfo.SetData(callbackData->data);
4357 T* instance = T::Unwrap(callbackInfo.This().As<Object>());
4358 auto cb = callbackData->callback;
4359 if (instance) (instance->*cb)(callbackInfo);
4360 return nullptr;
4361 });
4362}

4409inline napi_value InstanceWrap<T>::WrappedMethod(

4420// ObjectWrap<T> class
4422
4423template <typename T>
4424inline ObjectWrap<T>::ObjectWrap(const Napi::CallbackInfo& callbackInfo) {
4425 napi_env env = callbackInfo.Env();
4426 napi_value wrapper = callbackInfo.This();
4427 napi_status status;
4428 napi_ref ref;
4429 T* instance = static_cast<T*>(this);
4430 status = napi_wrap(env, wrapper, instance, FinalizeCallback, nullptr, &ref);
4431 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED_VOID(env, status);
4432
4433 Reference<Object>* instanceRef = instance;
4434 *instanceRef = Reference<Object>(env, ref);
4435}
4436
4437template <typename T>
4438inline ObjectWrap<T>::~ObjectWrap() {
4439 // If the JS object still exists at this point, remove the finalizer added
4440 // through `napi_wrap()`.
4441 if (!IsEmpty()) {
4442 Object object = Value();
4443 // It is not valid to call `napi_remove_wrap()` with an empty `object`.
4444 // This happens e.g. during garbage collection.
4445 if (!object.IsEmpty() && _construction_failed) {
4446 napi_remove_wrap(Env(), object, nullptr);
4447 }
4448 }
4449}
4450
4451template <typename T>
4452inline T* ObjectWrap<T>::Unwrap(Object wrapper) {
4453 void* unwrapped;
4454 napi_status status = napi_unwrap(wrapper.Env(), wrapper, &unwrapped);
4455 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(wrapper.Env(), status, nullptr);
4456 return static_cast<T*>(unwrapped);
4457}
4458
4459template <typename T>
4460inline Function ObjectWrap<T>::DefineClass(
4461 Napi::Env env,
4462 const char* utf8name,
4463 const size_t props_count,
4464 const napi_property_descriptor* descriptors,
4465 void* data) {
4466 napi_status status;
4467 std::vector<napi_property_descriptor> props(props_count);
4468
4469 // We copy the descriptors to a local array because before defining the class
4470 // we must replace static method property descriptors with value property
4471 // descriptors such that the value is a function-valued `napi_value` created
4472 // with `CreateFunction()`.
4473 //
4474 // This replacement could be made for instance methods as well, but V8 aborts
4475 // if we do that, because it expects methods defined on the prototype template
4476 // to have `FunctionTemplate`s.
4477 for (size_t index = 0; index < props_count; index++) {
4478 props[index] = descriptors[index];
4479 napi_property_descriptor* prop = &props[index];
4480 if (prop->method == T::StaticMethodCallbackWrapper) {
4481 status =
4482 CreateFunction(env,
4483 utf8name,
4484 prop->method,
4485 static_cast<StaticMethodCallbackData*>(prop->data),
4486 &(prop->value));
4487 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, Function());
4488 prop->method = nullptr;
4489 prop->data = nullptr;
4490 } else if (prop->method == T::StaticVoidMethodCallbackWrapper) {
4491 status =
4492 CreateFunction(env,
4493 utf8name,
4494 prop->method,
4495 static_cast<StaticVoidMethodCallbackData*>(prop->data),
4496 &(prop->value));
4497 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, Function());
4498 prop->method = nullptr;
4499 prop->data = nullptr;
4500 }
4501 }
4502
4503 napi_value value;
4504 status = napi_define_class(env,
4505 utf8name,
4506 NAPI_AUTO_LENGTH,
4507 T::ConstructorCallbackWrapper,
4508 data,
4509 props_count,
4510 props.data(),
4511 &value);
4512 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, Function());
4513
4514 // After defining the class we iterate once more over the property descriptors
4515 // and attach the data associated with accessors and instance methods to the
4516 // newly created JavaScript class.
4517 for (size_t idx = 0; idx < props_count; idx++) {
4518 const napi_property_descriptor* prop = &props[idx];
4519
4520 if (prop->getter == T::StaticGetterCallbackWrapper ||
4521 prop->setter == T::StaticSetterCallbackWrapper) {
4522 status = Napi::details::AttachData(
4523 env, value, static_cast<StaticAccessorCallbackData*>(prop->data));
4524 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, Function());
4525 } else {
4526 // InstanceWrap<T>::AttachPropData is responsible for attaching the data
4527 // of instance methods and accessors.
4528 T::AttachPropData(env, value, prop);
4529 }
4530 }
4531
4532 return Function(env, value);
4533}
4534
4535template <typename T>
4536inline Function ObjectWrap<T>::DefineClass(
4537 Napi::Env env,
4538 const char* utf8name,
4539 const std::initializer_list<ClassPropertyDescriptor<T>>& properties,
4540 void* data) {
4541 return DefineClass(
4542 env,
4543 utf8name,
4544 properties.size(),
4545 reinterpret_cast<const napi_property_descriptor*>(properties.begin()),
4546 data);
4547}

4792
4793template <typename T>
4794inline napi_value ObjectWrap<T>::ConstructorCallbackWrapper(
4795 napi_env env, napi_callback_info info) {
4796 napi_value new_target;
4797 napi_status status = napi_get_new_target(env, info, &new_target);
4798 if (status != napi_ok) return nullptr;
4799
4800 bool isConstructCall = (new_target != nullptr);
4801 if (!isConstructCall) {
4802 return details::WrapCallback(
4803 [&] { return T::OnCalledAsFunction(CallbackInfo(env, info)); });
4804 }
4805
4806 napi_value wrapper = details::WrapCallback([&] {
4807 CallbackInfo callbackInfo(env, info);
4808 T* instance = new T(callbackInfo);
4809#ifdef NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
4810 instance->_construction_failed = false;
4811#else
4812 if (callbackInfo.Env().IsExceptionPending()) {
4813 // We need to clear the exception so that removing the wrap might work.
4814 Error e = callbackInfo.Env().GetAndClearPendingException();
4815 delete instance;
4816 e.ThrowAsJavaScriptException();
4817 } else {
4818 instance->_construction_failed = false;
4819 }
4820#endif // NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
4821 return callbackInfo.This();
4822 });
4823
4824 return wrapper;
4825}
4826
4827template <typename T>
4828inline napi_value ObjectWrap<T>::StaticVoidMethodCallbackWrapper(
4829 napi_env env, napi_callback_info info) {
4830 return details::WrapCallback([&] {
4831 CallbackInfo callbackInfo(env, info);
4832 StaticVoidMethodCallbackData* callbackData =
4833 reinterpret_cast<StaticVoidMethodCallbackData*>(callbackInfo.Data());
4834 callbackInfo.SetData(callbackData->data);
4835 callbackData->callback(callbackInfo);
4836 return nullptr;
4837 });
4838}

4877template <typename T>
4878inline void ObjectWrap<T>::FinalizeCallback(napi_env env,
4879 void* data,
4880 void* /*hint*/) {

4891 return details::WrapCallback([&] {

4893 method(cbInfo, cbInfo[0]);
4894 return nullptr;
4895 });

5176// The OnAsyncWorkExecute method receives an napi_env argument. However, do NOT
5177// use it within this method, as it does not run on the JavaScript thread and
5178// must not run any method that would cause JavaScript to run. In practice,
5179// this means that almost any use of napi_env will be incorrect.
5180inline void AsyncWorker::OnAsyncWorkExecute(napi_env env, void* asyncworker) {
5181 AsyncWorker* self = static_cast<AsyncWorker*>(asyncworker);
5182 self->OnExecute(env);
5183}
5184// The OnExecute method receives an napi_env argument. However, do NOT
5185// use it within this method, as it does not run on the JavaScript thread and
5186// must not run any method that would cause JavaScript to run. In practice,
5187// this means that almost any use of napi_env will be incorrect.
5188inline void AsyncWorker::OnExecute(Napi::Env /*DO_NOT_USE*/) {
5189#ifdef NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
5190 try {
5191 Execute();
5192 } catch (const std::exception& e) {
5193 SetError(e.what());
5194 }
5195#else // NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
5196 Execute();
5197#endif // NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
5198}
5199
5200inline void AsyncWorker::OnAsyncWorkComplete(napi_env env,
5201 napi_status status,
5202 void* asyncworker) {
5203 AsyncWorker* self = static_cast<AsyncWorker*>(asyncworker);
5204 self->OnWorkComplete(env, status);
5205}
5206inline void AsyncWorker::OnWorkComplete(Napi::Env /*env*/, napi_status status) {
5207 if (status != napi_cancelled) {
5208 HandleScope scope(_env);
5209 details::WrapCallback([&] {
5210 if (_error.size() == 0) {
5211 OnOK();
5212 } else {
5213 OnError(Error::New(_env, _error));
5214 }
5215 return nullptr;
5216 });
5217 }
5218 if (!_suppress_destruct) {
5219 Destroy();
5220 }
5221}

5519 size_t maxQueueSize,
5520 size_t initialThreadCount,
5521 ContextType* context,
5522 Finalizer finalizeCallback,
5523 FinalizerDataType* data) {
5524 TypedThreadSafeFunction<ContextType, DataType, CallJs> tsfn;
5525
5526 auto* finalizeData = new details::
5527 ThreadSafeFinalize<ContextType, Finalizer, FinalizerDataType>(
5528 {data, finalizeCallback});
5529 napi_status status = napi_create_threadsafe_function(
5530 env,
5531 details::DefaultCallbackWrapper<
5532 CallbackType,
5533 TypedThreadSafeFunction<ContextType, DataType, CallJs>>(env,
5534 callback),
5535 resource,
5536 String::From(env, resourceName),
5537 maxQueueSize,
5538 initialThreadCount,
5539 finalizeData,
5540 details::ThreadSafeFinalize<ContextType, Finalizer, FinalizerDataType>::
5541 FinalizeFinalizeWrapperWithDataAndContext,
5542 context,
5543 CallJsInternal,
5544 &tsfn._tsfn);
5545 if (status != napi_ok) {
5546 delete finalizeData;
5547 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(
5548 env, status, TypedThreadSafeFunction<ContextType, DataType, CallJs>());
5549 }
5550
5551 return tsfn;
5552}

6049// static
6050template <typename ResourceString,
6051 typename ContextType,
6052 typename Finalizer,
6053 typename FinalizerDataType>
6054inline ThreadSafeFunction ThreadSafeFunction::New(napi_env env,
6055 const Function& callback,
6056 const Object& resource,
6057 ResourceString resourceName,
6058 size_t maxQueueSize,
6059 size_t initialThreadCount,
6060 ContextType* context,
6061 Finalizer finalizeCallback,
6062 FinalizerDataType* data,
6063 napi_finalize wrapper) {
6064 static_assert(details::can_make_string<ResourceString>::value ||
6065 std::is_convertible<ResourceString, napi_value>::value,
6066 "Resource name should be convertible to the string type");
6067
6068 ThreadSafeFunction tsfn;
6069 auto* finalizeData = new details::
6070 ThreadSafeFinalize<ContextType, Finalizer, FinalizerDataType>(
6071 {data, finalizeCallback});
6072 napi_status status =
6073 napi_create_threadsafe_function(env,
6074 callback,
6075 resource,
6076 Value::From(env, resourceName),
6077 maxQueueSize,
6078 initialThreadCount,
6079 finalizeData,
6080 wrapper,
6081 context,
6082 CallJS,
6083 &tsfn._tsfn);
6084 if (status != napi_ok) {
6085 delete finalizeData;
6086 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(env, status, ThreadSafeFunction());
6087 }
6088
6089 return tsfn;
6090}
6091
6092inline napi_status ThreadSafeFunction::CallInternal(
6093 CallbackWrapper* callbackWrapper,
6094 napi_threadsafe_function_call_mode mode) const {
6095 napi_status status =
6096 napi_call_threadsafe_function(_tsfn, callbackWrapper, mode);
6097 if (status != napi_ok && callbackWrapper != nullptr) {
6098 delete callbackWrapper;
6099 }
6100
6101 return status;
6102}
6103
6104// static
6105inline void ThreadSafeFunction::CallJS(napi_env env,
6106 napi_value jsCallback,
6107 void* /* context */,
6108 void* data) {
6109 if (env == nullptr && jsCallback == nullptr) {
6110 return;
6111 }
6112
6113 if (data != nullptr) {
6114 auto* callbackWrapper = static_cast<CallbackWrapper*>(data);
6115 (*callbackWrapper)(env, Function(env, jsCallback));
6116 delete callbackWrapper;
6117 } else if (jsCallback != nullptr) {
6118 Function(env, jsCallback).Call({});
6119 }
6120}

6123// Async Progress Worker Base class
6125template <typename DataType>
6126inline AsyncProgressWorkerBase<DataType>::AsyncProgressWorkerBase(
6127 const Object& receiver,
6128 const Function& callback,
6129 const char* resource_name,
6130 const Object& resource,
6131 size_t queue_size)
6132 : AsyncWorker(receiver, callback, resource_name, resource) {
6133 // Fill all possible arguments to work around ambiguous
6134 // ThreadSafeFunction::New signatures.
6135 _tsfn = ThreadSafeFunction::New(callback.Env(),
6136 callback,
6137 resource,
6138 resource_name,
6139 queue_size,
1, this,
6142 OnThreadSafeFunctionFinalize,
this);
6144}
6145
6146#if NAPI_VERSION > 4
6147template <typename DataType>
6148inline AsyncProgressWorkerBase<DataType>::AsyncProgressWorkerBase(
6149 Napi::Env env,
6150 const char* resource_name,
6151 const Object& resource,
6152 size_t queue_size)
6153 : AsyncWorker(env, resource_name, resource) {
6154 // TODO: Once the changes to make the callback optional for threadsafe
6155 // functions are available on all versions we can remove the dummy Function
6156 // here.
6157 Function callback;
6158 // Fill all possible arguments to work around ambiguous
6159 // ThreadSafeFunction::New signatures.
6160 _tsfn = ThreadSafeFunction::New(env,
6161 callback,
6162 resource,
6163 resource_name,
6164 queue_size,
1, this,
6167 OnThreadSafeFunctionFinalize,
this);
6169}
6170#endif
6171
6172template <typename DataType>
6173inline AsyncProgressWorkerBase<DataType>::~AsyncProgressWorkerBase() {
6174 // Abort pending tsfn call.
6175 // Don't send progress events after we've already completed.
6176 // It's ok to call ThreadSafeFunction::Abort and ThreadSafeFunction::Release
6177 // duplicated.
6178 _tsfn.Abort();
6179}
6180
6181template <typename DataType>
6182inline void AsyncProgressWorkerBase<DataType>::OnAsyncWorkProgress(
6183 Napi::Env /* env */, Napi::Function /* jsCallback */, void* data) {
6184 ThreadSafeData* tsd = static_cast<ThreadSafeData*>(data);
6185 tsd->asyncprogressworker()->OnWorkProgress(tsd->data());
6186 delete tsd;
6187}
6188
6189template <typename DataType>
6190inline napi_status AsyncProgressWorkerBase<DataType>::NonBlockingCall(
6191 DataType* data) {
6192 auto tsd = new AsyncProgressWorkerBase::ThreadSafeData(this, data);
6193 auto ret = _tsfn.NonBlockingCall(tsd, OnAsyncWorkProgress);
6194 if (ret != napi_ok) {
6195 delete tsd;
6196 }
6197 return ret;
6198}
6199
6200template <typename DataType>
6201inline void AsyncProgressWorkerBase<DataType>::OnWorkComplete(
6202 Napi::Env /* env */, napi_status status) {
6203 _work_completed = true;
6204 _complete_status = status;
6205 _tsfn.Release();
6206}
6207
6208template <typename DataType>
6209inline void AsyncProgressWorkerBase<DataType>::OnThreadSafeFunctionFinalize(
6210 Napi::Env env, void* /* data */, AsyncProgressWorkerBase* context) {
6211 if (context->_work_completed) {
6212 context->AsyncWorker::OnWorkComplete(env, context->_complete_status);
6213 }
6214}

6292template <class T>
6293inline void AsyncProgressWorker<T>::OnWorkProgress(void*) {
6294 T* data;
6295 size_t size;
6296 bool signaled;
6297 {
6298 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->_mutex);
6299 data = this->_asyncdata;
6300 size = this->_asyncsize;
6301 signaled = this->_signaled;
6302 this->_asyncdata = nullptr;
6303 this->_asyncsize = 0;
6304 this->_signaled = false;
6305 }
6306
6314 if (data == nullptr && !signaled) {
6315 return;
6316 }
6317
6318 this->OnProgress(data, size);
6319 delete[] data;
6320}
6321
6322template <class T>
6323inline void AsyncProgressWorker<T>::SendProgress_(const T* data, size_t count) {
6324 T* new_data = new T[count];
6325 std::copy(data, data + count, new_data);
6326
6327 T* old_data;
6328 {
6329 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->_mutex);
6330 old_data = _asyncdata;
6331 _asyncdata = new_data;
6332 _asyncsize = count;
6333 _signaled = false;
6334 }
6335 this->NonBlockingCall(nullptr);
6336
6337 delete[] old_data;
6338}
6339
6340template <class T>
6341inline void AsyncProgressWorker<T>::Signal() {
6342 {
6343 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->_mutex);
6344 _signaled = true;
6345 }
6346 this->NonBlockingCall(static_cast<T*>(nullptr));
6347}

6531template <typename T>
6532inline Napi::Object Addon<T>::DefineProperties(
6533 Object object, const std::initializer_list<AddonProp>& props) {
6534 const napi_property_descriptor* properties =
6535 reinterpret_cast<const napi_property_descriptor*>(props.begin());
6536 size_t size = props.size();
6537 napi_status status =
6538 napi_define_properties(object.Env(), object, size, properties);
6539 NAPI_THROW_IF_FAILED(object.Env(), status, object);
6540 for (size_t idx = 0; idx < size; idx++)
6541 T::AttachPropData(object.Env(), object, &properties[idx]);
6542 return object;
6543}
